name: brand
description:
Class strings for the theme's second identity color (`brand`) on surfaces and decoration. Identity only: never for hover, focus, selection or status.

- **`brandSurface`**: a solid brand surface whose focus ring follows the text.
- **`brandGradient`**: a primary → brand gradient fill.
- **`brandGradientBorder`**: a primary → brand gradient border; set the surface underneath with `--brand-border-fill`.
- **`brandGlow`**: a soft brand glow (replaces the element's shadow).
- **`brandSpinningBorder`**: a wrapper with a spinning gradient edge for something in progress, static with reduced motion.
